name: Denver
intro: Denver’s stars come from the MICHELIN Guide Colorado, first published in 2023. Two of them belong to Johnny Curiel’s Mexican restaurants, Alma Fonda Fina and Mezcalería Alma, which are à la carte, so a starred meal here can cost far less than a tasting menu. Boulder’s and Aspen’s starred restaurants are on the Colorado page. Prices are in US dollars, per person before tax and tip (or the service charge some restaurants add), checked October 2026.
